slots.name: single asset limit
slots.sentence: For example, no one asset can exceed 25% of the portfolio's value, and the top five holdings cannot exceed 50% of the overall value, according to Kitces.com.

slots.name: exchange fund holding period
slots.sentence: One disadvantage is the seven-year holding period for participants to redeem their units.

slots.name: ETF creation cost
slots.sentence: Fees are one reason. It can cost $200,000-$300,000 to create an ETF, said John Pantekidis, managing partner and general counsel at TwinFocus in Boston.

slots.name: firm asset threshold
slots.sentence: Some firms suggest investors should have at least $25 million of appreciated stocks to include in the ETF for it to be a viable option, but Pantekidis sets the bar even higher, saying it doesn't make sense for anyone with less than $100 million of stocks to include.

slots.name: WSTA meeting date
slots.sentence: Officials from the IRS and Treasury had met in July with members of the Wall Street Tax Association to discuss the kinds of transactions the government has taken an interest in, including questionable Section 351 exchanges.
